name: Tabnine

tiers.name: Code Assistant

limits.usage: Unlimited when using your own LLM on-prem/VPC; Tabnine-provided LLM access billed at provider list price + 5% handling fee
limits.deployment: SaaS, VPC, on-prem, or air-gapped; zero code retention

estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: Platform-fee plan: no token bundle included; Tabnine-provided LLM access is billed at provider list price + 5% handling fee, BYO LLM endpoint is unlimited. Figures are fee-equivalent at ~$2.00/M (conservative), ~$1.00/M (midpoint) and ~$0.50/M (optimistic) for cross-plan comparison only

tiers.notes: Completions + grounded chat in IDEs; Jira integration; SOC 2/ISO 27001

tiers.name: Agentic Platform

limits.usage: Same LLM economics as Code Assistant
limits.included: Context Engine, Tabnine CLI agents, MCP tool use, headless agents (optional add-on)

estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: Platform-fee plan: no token bundle included; same LLM economics as Code Assistant. Figures are fee-equivalent at ~$2.00/M / ~$1.00/M / ~$0.50/M for cross-plan comparison only

tiers.notes: Adds autonomous agents, Coaching Guidelines, Jira/Confluence/database MCP access

tiers.name: Enterprise (Custom)

limits.volume: Quote-based; IP indemnification subject to terms

tiers.notes: Headless agent add-on priced separately at tabnine.com/headless-agent-pricing

gotchas: Tabnine was acquired by Tricentis (agentic quality engineering) and consumer self-serve tiers (Starter/Pro $15) are discontinued
Pricing is enterprise-first: annual per-user subscription with quote-based procurement
Using your own LLM endpoint = unlimited usage; Tabnine-provided LLM access adds a 5% handling fee over provider list prices
Reserve-token model means monthly token totals are not fixed
tosHighlights: Zero code retention; no training on your code on all plans
License-safe usage with provenance and attribution reporting
dataTraining: Training never occurs on customer code
